tools.name: get_knowmapped_update_schema
tools.description: Return the authoritative, versioned schema, graph_type_operations and examples for atomic KnowMapped concept-map and Futures Wheel patches. Call this before constructing an update instead of guessing operation or field names.

tools.name: search_knowmapped_maps
tools.description: Search maps available to the connected KnowMapped account. Use this when a user refers to a saved map or wants to find prior concepts; existing ownership and sharing permissions are enforced server-side.

tools.name: get_knowmapped_map_adjacency
tools.description: Return one concept and its directly connected concepts and relationships without retrieving the full graph. Provide node_id or an exact unique label.

tools.name: get_knowmapped_wheel_branch
tools.description: Read a wheel consequence, its ancestors, inherited domain and paginated descendants, including collapsed content. Omit the node reference to start at the central change. Compact keeps causal metadata; full adds descriptions, resources and provenance.

tools.name: export_knowmapped_map
tools.description: Return an import-ready .know JSON file for an authorized concept map or Futures Wheel. Serialize file as UTF-8 JSON under filename. Includes every node, including collapsed branches, presentation and provenance; does not publish or create a map. Visual exports remain in the app.

tools.name: get_knowmapped_layout_summary

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish_knowmapped_map · Private data: get_knowmapped_map, export_knowmapped_map, preflight_knowmapped_map_creation, set_knowmapped_map_visibility, set_knowmapped_live_view, publish_knowmapped_map · Public sink: export_knowmapped_map, update_knowmapped_map, set_knowmapped_map_visibility, set_knowmapped_live_view, publish_knowmapped_map, get_knowmapped_publication_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish_knowmapped_map · Private data: get_knowmapped_map, export_knowmapped_map, preflight_knowmapped_map_creation, set_knowmapped_map_visibility, set_knowmapped_live_view, publish_knowmapped_map · Public sink: export_knowmapped_map, update_knowmapped_map, set_knowmapped_map_visibility, set_knowmapped_live_view, publish_knowmapped_map, get_knowmapped_publication_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
